name: immunoglobulin heavy locus

function.text: IGH is the immunoglobulin heavy-chain locus; its variable, diversity, joining, and constant segments support antibody production through somatic rearrangement in B cells.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Plasmacytoma; Burkitt lymphoma; Follicular lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
